influences.name: Queen
influences.context: in 1981, Queen were touring for their album The Game when they made a pit stop in Brazil where he and his brother Igor witnessed the British rock band for the first time. He says the concert was life-changing, and it immediately introduced Cavalera and his brother to other hard rock and metal bands.
